title: Real market values + housekeeping
items: Squad values in the ratings file replaced with verified Transfermarkt figures (June 2026) for the top ~30 teams — the model now runs on real numbers, not estimates. Star-player values verified for the top squads (Mbappé, Haaland and Yamal all around €200M; Argentina's top value is Enzo Fernández/Julián Álvarez at ~€90M, not Messi).
Removed the dead FIFA news feed that errored on every fetch (the working backup feed remains).
Odds history now self-cleans: entries from other sports (inherited during an old migration) are pruned automatically.
